description: Native probe mutants. Each must compile in the accepted Geth tree and must fail the oracle in the measured run.

mutants.name: hook_never_installed
mutants.reason: No BLOCKHASH lookup goes through the dependency log, so no request is recorded.

mutants.name: bypass_saved_bytes
mutants.reason: Native code receives the source answer instead of the saved bytes; poisoned replays then fail native validation.

mutants.name: native_lookup_bypass
mutants.reason: Native code receives a fresh native lookup instead of the saved bytes; the replay of a saved poisoned log then imports the block.

mutants.name: crash_before_persist
mutants.reason: The crash happens before the response is persisted, so the retry sees a shorter durable frontier.
